outcome: type of home tube feeding at discharge (NGT vs GT)
cohort: The study included 3521 preterm infants from the Children's Hospitals Neonatal Database who were discharged home with either a nasogastric tube (NGT) or gastrostomy tube (GT) between 2015-2020.
finding: Differences in the type of home tube feeding at discharge (NGT vs. GT) were significantly associated with infant race and ethnicity, small for gestational age (SGA) status, insurance type, and showed significant inter-center variability.
